title: 2019-20 Panini Mosaic Pink Prizm #201 Jarrett Culver Minnesota Timberwolves Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is a 2019-20 Panini Mosaic Rookie Card Pink Prizm #201 featuring basketball player Jarrett Culver from the Minnesota Timberwolves. The card is part of a set of 20 cards with a print run of 20, and it is serial numbered. The card is in excellent condition and is perfect for any collector or fan of the National Basketball Association (NBA).

The card has features such as a parallel/variety, base set, and rookie designation. It is a sports trading card manufactured by Panini and is from the 2019 season. Please note that the autograph status of the card is not available. This is a great addition to any sports trading card collection and a must-have for any fan of Jarrett Culver or the Minnesota Timberwolves.
